text: Ko haɗno sanamuuji ɗi ɓe jogitornoo ɗin reweteeɗi gaanin Allah, ɗi ɓe ɓaɗtinoraynoo dewe e kirse, faaboo ɓe? Kono ɗi hunnantaa ɗum. Wurin, ɗin wirnanike ɓe fewndo ka ɓe hatonjini e majji; ko ɗum wonunoo fenaande e fefinannde maɓɓe, nde ɓe aaƴoraynoo wonnde ɗin sanamuuji tefanoyay ɓe ka Allah.
